rationale:
Both invert retrieval into
on-device decision operations and are defensible directions. A supplies richer low-level machinery
(IR, atoms, split transcript) but under-justifies novelty and leaves branch-coverage evaluation
incomplete. B offers a clearer API/HSM analogy, explicit attack mitigation and a falsifiable claim
about coverage, making it the safer, more testable proposal despite being slightly less
implementation-detailed.
